value.notes: First turn: exploring basics. Plan: check step/bump, dash recharge (should show Dash 5 after dash), pause freezing timer, pause+move same tick (rest of tick ignored), Enter resumes, and HUD vs state consistency.

Run 1 showed: (a) dash-down from (2,1) landed on (2,3) across wall (2,2). (b) stepping on spikes at (3,3) with score 0 gave score 65036 (0-500 wrapping). Verifying with: right, dash-down, right. Next: check down+right bump behaviour.

Previous: dash-down from (2,1) landed on (2,3), passing wall (2,2) (suspected collision bug). Stepping on spikes at (3,3) with score 0 gave 65036 (score underflow wrap). Verifying the underflow with a plain walk: right,right,down,down (no dash). Next: verify dash-through-wall with [right dash-down] alone, then minimize.

Testing spike underflow with plain walk: down,down,right,right onto spikes (3,3) with score 0. Expect score stays 0. Earlier runs suggested score 65036 after spikes at score 0 (wrap). Also suspect dash-down from (2,1) passed wall (2,2); verify later with [right dash-down] alone.

Budget is nearly exhausted, so I'm stopping here. One confirmed bug: stepping onto spikes while the score is below 500 wraps the score around to about 65,000 instead of clamping at 0. Reproduced in runs 2 and 4 (seed 1). The only route to spikes (3,3) passes the coin at (1,3), so the 4-token sequence is the minimal repro. Unverified suspicion: a dash-down from (2,1) may pass through the wall at (2,2). It is not reported because I did not confirm it.

reports.title: Spike hit below 500 points wraps score to ~65,000 instead of clamping at 0
reports.observed: After collecting the coin (score 100) and stepping onto spikes at (3,3), score becomes 65136 (wrapped negative value) and lives drop to 2.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit.
